description: An old stone bridge crossing the silver river. Lanterns flicker each evening.
Bustling market with stalls selling spices, trinkets, and rumors.
A grand wooden building where merchants and artisans gather.
A narrow trail follows the river into dense alder woods. Broken branches and old boot prints mark the muddy verge.
A weathered loading dock behind the guild hall. Flat-bottomed barges unload beneath a cramped dockmaster's office.
